preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [n, a, b]) and n <= 100 and a <= 15 and b <= 15 and n > a + b
preconditions.description: Input consists of three integers n, a, b where 1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 0 ≤ a, b ≤ 15, and n > a + b.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(isinstance(int(t), int) and 1 <= int(t) <= 50000 for t in stdout.strip().split()) and len(stdout.strip().split()) == n)
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no valid sequence exists) or a space-separated sequence of n integers, each between 1 and 50000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda seq: any(seq))(stdout.strip().split()) and (lambda seq: all(int(seq[i]) > sum(int(seq[j]) for j in range(i)) for i in range(n) if i == 0 or any(int(seq[i]) > int(seq[j]) for j in range(i))))(stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the sequence must satisfy: for each groom i (1-based), if i > 1, then either (a) the groom's fortune is strictly greater than all previous grooms' fortunes (counted as 'Oh...' events), or (b) the groom's fortune is strictly greater than the sum of all previous grooms' fortunes (counted as 'Wow!' events).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda seq: sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if any(int(seq[i]) > int(seq[j]) for j in range(i))) == a)(stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the number of 'Oh...' events (grooms richer than all previous ones) must equal exactly a.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (lambda seq: sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if int(seq[i]) > sum(int(seq[j]) for j in range(i))) == b)(stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the number of 'Wow!' events (grooms richer than the sum of all previous ones) must equal exactly b.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (lambda seq: sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if int(seq[i]) > sum(int(seq[j]) for j in range(i))) + sum(1 for i in range(1, n) if any(int(seq[i]) > int(seq[j]) for j in range(i))) == a + b)(stdout.strip().split())
postconditions.description: If output is not '-1', the total number of 'Oh...' and 'Wow!' events must equal exactly a + b.
